trigger.summary: User initially requests an authenticated resource monitor design and deployment.

quoted_messages.text: Design and deploy a resource monitor with authentication.

agent_reactions.summary: Agent investigated monitor architecture, drafted options, and asked for server details before deployment.

outcomes.summary: Resource monitor design options were investigated.

terminal_state.summary: Deployment could not proceed without target server details.

trigger.summary: User replaces authenticated deployment with a public access deployment prompt handoff.

quoted_messages.text: Change the scope: use public access without authentication. Only deliver metrics-prompt.md for another agent to deploy; do not deploy it yourself.

agent_reactions.summary: Agent wrote metrics-prompt.md with public access settings, resource collection steps, deployment instructions, and verification commands; the prompt was read back.

outcomes.summary: metrics-prompt.md was delivered for another agent to execute.

observed_checks.summary: Read-back confirmed metrics-prompt.md exists and includes the requested public access configuration and deployment instructions.

terminal_state.summary: The user-authorized prompt handoff is delivered; deployment belongs to another agent.
